title: Tenqui's MC: Director's Cut
body:
# Tenqui’s MC: Director’s Cut / 尘柒的MC：导演剪辑版

Note: The English version was translated from Chinese by ChatGPT and may contain inaccuracies.

文末提供中文版，英文版由ChatGPT翻译。

# English Ver.

**A lightweight, vanilla-focused Minecraft modpack.**  

This modpack is created based on **personal preference**, aiming to enhance the overall Minecraft experience while keeping vanilla gameplay intact.  

In short: this is a relaxed, casual modpack for players who simply want to enjoy Minecraft without excessive systems or complexity.  

If you are looking for a modpack without heavy tech trees, RPG systems, or overwhelming mechanics — just a more comfortable vanilla experience — this modpack may be for you.  

---

## Status

This modpack is currently in **Beta**.
Mod content may change between versions.

---

## Compared to Vanilla Survival, this modpack adds:

(All features work in singleplayer.)

### Client-side focused content

- **3D Skin Layers**  
  Converts the second layer of player skins into 3D geometry.  
  *(Disabled by default due to potential visual issues.)*

- **Reese’s Sodium Options**  
  Improved configuration UI for Sodium.

- **Xaero’s World Map & Minimap**  
  Full-featured in-game mapping.

- **Do a Barrel Roll**  
  Adds roll-based Elytra flight.  
  *(May cause dizziness for some players.)*

- **Shoulder Surfing Reloaded**  
  Adds a third-person over-the-shoulder camera view.

- **Real Camera**  
  More immersive first-person camera behavior.

---

### Server-side focused content

- **Chunky**  
  Pre-generates chunks to reduce server lag.

- **Show Me Your Skin!**  
  Allows players to customize armor visibility.

- **Lootr**  
  Individual loot for each player.

- **Carry On**  
  Pick up blocks and mobs.

- **Animal Feeding Trough**  
  Animals automatically feed and breed.

- **Let Your Friend Eating!**  
  Feed other players by right-clicking them.

- **Right Click Harvest**  
  Harvest and replant crops with a single click.

---

## Quality of Life & Immersion

In addition to optimization mods, this pack includes many small improvements such as:

- Better animations and particles  
- Enhanced UI and HUD elements  
- Improved sounds and footsteps  
- Visual polish and smooth transitions  
- Inventory and interaction conveniences  

---

## Resource Packs Included

You may freely disable resource packs you do not need.

- **Fresh Animations**  
  by FreshLX

- **Dramatic Skys (Demo)**  
  by thebaum64

- **New Glowing Ores (Default)**  
  by GridExpert


---

## Credits

- **Fast Leaf Decay** — by **olafskiii**  
  Thanks for allowing modpack usage.  
  Original project hosted on CurseForge.

---

## Community & Support
If you have questions, suggestions, or issues, feel free to join the [QQ group](https://qm.qq.com/q/EQrjTSPgYi) for discussion.


# 中文版

欢迎尝试尘柒的生存增强包。 
本整合包纯凭个人喜好制作，旨在最小化修改原版玩法的前提下增强游戏体验  
简单来说，就是养老包  
如果你想找一个没有太多花里胡哨功能的整合包，只想舒舒服服享受原版玩法，那么我希望你能喜欢这个整合包;) 

### 本整合包尚在**Beta**阶段，mod内容可能随时更改，请知悉

## 相对于原版生存，本整合包增加了以下内容：
（单人游戏中这些内容均可加载）

`客户端内容`   
[[3D 皮肤层] 3D Skin Layers](https://modrinth.com/mod/3dskinlayers)，将玩家皮肤上的第二层从贴图替换为3D模型   >>存在潜在的模型观赏性bug，**默认关闭**
[[Reese的钠视频界面] Reese's Sodium Options](https://modrinth.com/mod/reeses-sodium-options)， 修改 Sodium 的选项界面，提高用户使用体验  
[[Xaero的世界地图]](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-world-map) & [[Xaero的小地图]](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap)，提供MC地图使用      
[[滚筒飞行] Do a Barrel Roll](https://modrinth.com/mod/do-a-barrel-roll) 说真的，这可能有点晕  
[[越肩视角重置] Shoulder Surfing Reloaded](https://modrinth.com/mod/shoulder-surfing-reloaded) 在原版三个视角的基础上增加了第四个越肩视角  
[[真实相机] Real Camera](https://modrinth.com/mod/real-camera) 将让你的第一人称视角更加真实  

`服务端内容`   
[[预生成区块] Chunky](https://modrinth.com/plugin/chunky) 能够预加载区块，减小服务器压力  
[[让我看看！] Show Me Your Skin!](https://modrinth.com/mod/show-me-your-skin) 你可以自由设置自己的盔甲可见度  
[[战利品] Lootr](https://modrinth.com/mod/lootr) 让每个玩家的战利品独立起来  
[[搬运] Carry on](https://modrinth.com/mod/carry-on) 使得你能搬运箱子与生物  
[[动物喂养槽] Animal Feeding Trough](https://modrinth.com/mod/animal_feeding_trough) 有了它，动物就会自己吃饲料繁殖  
[[让你的朋友吃！] Let Your Friend Eating!](https://modrinth.com/mod/let-your-friend-eating!) 你可以右键玩家来投喂，所以不要没事拿着食物右键玩家哦  
[[右键收割] RightClickHarvest](https://modrinth.com/mod/rightclickharvest) 你可以右键成熟的作物来快捷收割与种植  

---

## 除了优化模组之外，此整合包还包含许多细微的改进，例如：

- 更流畅的动画和粒子效果
- 增强的用户界面和HUD元素
- 改进的音效和脚步声
- 更精细的视觉效果和更流畅的过渡
- 更便捷的物品栏和交互方式

---
